title: Terminal-space coherent pairing
statement: For a simplicial set D, the terminal coefficient model uses the coherent space-valued Yoneda pairing with both variables and all higher precomposition and postcomposition simplices. The pairing is the declaration [def-coef-infinity-presheaf-yoneda].

source.place: Gepner--Haugseng Sections 4.3--4.4, terminal monoidal category specialization
